rationale: Among the three complete arms, differential evolution plus snooker has the largest worst-chain steps-per-tau and smallest worst-chain relative tau change in both states.
Its all-pair normalized median and tail differences are below one in both states, with no undefined comparisons.
The n4 relative tau change remains above 0.10 at the pilot horizon; the pilot does not establish confirmatory passage.
next_study: SparseMix-2 with new initialization and sampler seeds and a separately frozen long-horizon protocol
